title: Production analytics
summary: A manufacturing SaaS for two opposite users: managers reading large volumes of data, and operators on the shop floor with no time for screens.

meta.label: Platforms
meta.value: Web on desktop and mobile, shop-floor tablet

meta.label: Scope
meta.value: Product UX and UI, rebrand, illustration, motion

sections.heading: Helping factories waste less
body: Evocon is a startup that helps manufacturers improve production performance and waste less time and material. I designed for both sides of the product: office software for managers, and tablet software for operators on the line.

media.alt: Office dashboard with OEE, scrap, quantity and downtime charts
media.caption: Office dashboard

sections.heading: Two users, opposite needs
body: Managers work with large volumes of data in tables and charts on PC and mobile. Operators need to report what's happening on the line in as few taps as possible. One product had to serve both.
sections.pull: Mountains of factory data turned into one clear answer, and a shop-floor screen that asks for almost nothing.

sections.heading: Data that answers a question
body: For managers, the aim was to make the data easy to act on: pinpoint the exact problem holding production back, see whether things are improving over time, and read the real-time state of every line.

media.alt: Improvement view for reducing machine reset time
media.caption: Improvement tracking

sections.heading: A shop floor screen you can read from across the room
body: For operators, I kept the tablet app minimal, with as few presses as possible to get information from the floor to management. Slowdowns had to be impossible to miss, so speed states are animated and color-coded.

media.alt: Shop-floor tablet factory view with live station status
media.caption: Operator tablet

sections.heading: A friendlier brand for a teaching product
body: I led Evocon's rebrand. Part of Evocon's mission is teaching users about efficient production, so the brand needed to feel more contemporary and approachable. Drag the slider to compare the old and new site.

sections.heading: Illustration and motion in the product
body: A friendly character, simple illustrations and animated icons explain production concepts at a glance. Icons animate on hover, or on press on tablets, and were exported with Lottie so they could be reused across the product.

media.alt: Brand illustration of a character on the factory floor
media.caption: Brand illustration

sections.heading: Recognized for design
body: In 2019, Evocon won the EAS award for Best Design Implementation.
